text: No state shareholder (London/NYSE-listed), but a sustained documented adverse record: the US court found BP grossly negligent over the 2010 Deepwater Horizon spill and BP paid a $20.8bn civil settlement with the US and five Gulf states.
short: No state shareholder (London/NYSE-listed), but a sustained documented adverse record: the US court found BP grossly negligent over the 2010 Deepwater Horizon spill….

source.name: US Department of Justice - 'U.S. and Five Gulf States Reach Historic Settlement with BP'
source.quote: The federal lawsuit culminated in a three-phase civil trial in which the United States proved, among other things, that the spill was caused by BP’s gross negligence.

additionalSources.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, 'Deepwater Horizon – BP Gulf of America Oil Spill' (enforcement case page)
